page.让 AI 助手在后台持续运行，前提是拥有可靠的权限边界。Pot 在节点控制层强制: Running assistants continuously in the background requires hard boundaries. Pot enforces OS sandboxing, zero-wildcard command rules, and hardware-backed secret storage at the node control layer—models can never escalate their own privileges.
page.三级机器执行策略与原生系统沙箱: Three-Tier Machine Execution Policy & Native OS Sandbox
page.常规命令默认在 SRT 原生沙箱（macOS Seatbelt 或 Linux: Standard commands run inside the native SRT sandbox (macOS Seatbelt or Linux bubblewrap / seccomp). Only the active task workspace is writable; system toolchains are read-only, and private user directories, runtime state, and unrelated Unix sockets are blocked.
page.由节点所有者显式授权后，允许跳过 SRT 沙箱直接在宿主机执行。但任何匹配到显式: When explicitly enabled by the node owner, commands may bypass the SRT sandbox and run on the host. However, any matching explicit deny_host rule always takes highest precedence and blocks execution immediately.
page.立即禁止该机器启动任何新的命令或文件补丁，覆盖所有历史授权，仅保留已有进程的输出: Immediately blocks the machine from starting any new commands or file patches, overriding all prior approvals while allowing log inspection and cleanup of existing processes.
page.拒绝危险通配符：精确到完整上下文的命令审批: No Dangerous Wildcards: Context-Bound Command Approvals
page.当任务确需跳出沙箱（request_unsandboxed: true）时，必须: When a task genuinely needs host access (request_unsandboxed: true), it must state a reason and wait for your approval. Pot permission rules never allow prefix matching or wildcards:
page.永久规则同时绑定完整命令文本、规范化工作目录 (cwd)、Shell 环境、交互: Persistent rules bind the exact command string, canonical working directory (cwd), shell environment, interactive mode, and explicit credential refs. npm test, npm install, and npm test && curl are treated as completely distinct commands.
page.支持 allow_always（本机永久记住该精确命令）、allow_task（: Supports allow_always (remember this exact command on this node), allow_task (valid only for the active task run and destroyed afterward), and deny (block immediately).
page.Agent Link 绝不向远端节点授予本机执行权；委派给 Codex 的任务若: Agent Link never grants remote peers local execution authority; if a task delegated to Codex triggers a human approval, the request routes back to your Pot UI.
page.需要访问宿主机 SSH / Git 凭据向远端仓库推送已验证的 Release: Needs access to host SSH / Git credentials to push the verified release tag to origin.
page.AES-256-GCM 凭据加密与进程级瞬态注入: AES-256-GCM Encrypted Secrets & Transient Process Injection
page.主密钥绝不存入数据库。macOS 上存储于系统 Keychain（pot.con: The master key is never stored in the database. On macOS it lives in the system Keychain (pot.control.secrets); on Linux it uses a 0600 key file or POT_SECRET_KEY_FILE. If locked or unavailable, Pot fails closed and never falls back to plaintext.
page.所有模型 Provider API Key 与 OAuth Token 均采用: All provider API keys and OAuth tokens are encrypted with AES-256-GCM (unique 96-bit nonce per write) in SQLite. Business logic holds only an immutable secret_ref, and management APIs only report configured status.
page.密钥永远不会进入模型 Prompt、聊天记录、任务检查点或跨节点消息。GitHu: Secrets never enter model prompts, chat transcripts, task checkpoints, or cross-node messages. Tokens like GitHub Device Flow OAuth are injected into subprocess environment memory only at spawn time, auto-refreshed 30s before expiry, and wiped on exit.

page.按职责划分助手（如代码实现、日常运维、资料整理），各自保留长期上下文与规范文件。: Organize assistants by role (development, ops, research), each retaining its own long-term context and workspace instructions.
page.耗时任务在后台独立运行，不阻塞当前对话；可随时查看执行日志、追加说明或中止任务。: Long-running work executes asynchronously in the background without blocking chat; inspect logs, send follow-up instructions, or cancel anytime.
page.支持 Cron 定时任务与 GitHub 通知轮询，按预设条件自动发起后台巡检或: Run cron schedules and poll GitHub notifications to trigger background checks or workflows automatically.
page.跨设备连接外部 Agent，统一委派与回收结果: Connect external agents across machines to delegate work and collect results
page.可在服务器上运行 Pot 并通过浏览器访问，同时通过 Agent Link 连接: Run Pot on a server with Web UI access and use Agent Link to dispatch coding tasks to Codex on your Mac.
page.各节点维护独立的模型配置、工作目录与本地审批规则，通过加密通道通信。: Each node keeps its own model settings, workspace, and local approval rules over an encrypted link.
page.沙箱隔离、精确命令审批与密钥加密: Sandbox isolation, exact command approvals, and encrypted secrets
page.基于 SRT 原生沙箱（macOS Seatbelt / Linux bubbl: Built on native SRT sandboxing (macOS Seatbelt / Linux bubblewrap), zero-wildcard command approvals, and AES-256-GCM secret storage with on-demand in-memory decryption.
page.原生系统沙箱、精确命令审批与按需内存解密: Native OS sandboxing, exact command approvals, and on-demand in-memory decryption
page.后台自动执行任务需要明确的权限边界与凭据隔离。Pot 在控制层通过系统沙箱限制文: Unattended background tasks require strict permission boundaries and credential isolation. Pot enforces OS sandboxes at the control layer, requires exact-match approvals for host commands, and stores secrets encrypted at rest—decrypting them in memory only at the moment of use.
page.机器执行策略与 SRT 原生沙箱: Machine execution policies and native SRT sandbox
page.命令默认在 SRT 原生沙箱（macOS Seatbelt 或 Linux bu: Commands run inside the native SRT sandbox (macOS Seatbelt or Linux bubblewrap / seccomp) by default. Only the active task workspace is writable; system toolchains are read-only, while personal directories, runtime config, and unrelated sockets are masked.
page.由节点所有者显式切换后，允许命令跳过沙箱直接在宿主机执行。但显式配置的 deny: When explicitly enabled by the node owner, commands bypass the sandbox and run on the host. Explicit deny_host rules still take precedence and block matching commands.
page.禁止该机器启动任何新命令或文件修改操作，覆盖已有授权规则，仅允许读取已运行进程的: Blocks the machine from starting any new commands or file modifications, overriding existing approvals while still allowing output reads and cleanup for running processes.
page.当任务需要跳出沙箱执行（request_unsandboxed: true）时，: When a task requests unsandboxed host execution (request_unsandboxed: true), it must state its reason and wait for approval. Permission rules never use prefix matching or wildcards:
page.永久授权规则同时绑定完整命令字符串、规范化工作目录 (cwd)、Shell、交互: Saved rules bind the exact command string, canonical working directory (cwd), shell, interactive mode, and credential references. npm test, npm install, and npm test && curl are treated as distinct commands.
page.支持 allow_always（本机记住该精确命令组合）、allow_task（: Supports allow_always (persisted on the machine for that exact command tuple), allow_task (valid only for the active task run), and deny.
page.Agent Link 连接不会向远端授予本机执行权；委派给远端 Codex 的任: Agent Link never grants remote nodes local execution authority; if a task delegated to remote Codex triggers an approval, the prompt is routed back to your conversation.
page.加密保管与仅使用时内存解密: Encrypted storage at rest and on-demand in-memory decryption
page.加密主密钥不写入数据库。macOS 存储于系统 Keychain（pot.con: The master key is never stored in the database. On macOS it lives in the system Keychain (pot.control.secrets); on Linux it is stored in a dedicated 0600 key file or supplied via POT_SECRET_KEY_FILE. If unavailable, Pot fails closed rather than falling back to plaintext.
page.API Key 与 OAuth 令牌在写入 SQLite 前均使用 AES-25: API keys and OAuth tokens are encrypted with AES-256-GCM (using a fresh 96-bit nonce per write) before being stored in SQLite. Config tables and management APIs only store and return immutable secret_ref identifiers, never plaintext values.
page.仅在使用瞬间解密注入: Decrypted in Memory Only on Use
page.密钥平时始终以密文存放，不进入 Prompt、聊天记录或日志。仅在发起模型请求，: Secrets remain encrypted at rest and never enter prompts, chat logs, or checkpoints. The control layer decrypts a secret in memory only at the exact moment an inference request is sent or a subprocess declaring that credential is spawned—injecting it into a transient process environment that is discarded on exit.
page.了解完整的沙箱边界、权限存储结构与密钥加密实现细节：: Read the full technical specifications for sandboxing, permission storage, and secret encryption:
